correctness.rationale: CRT gives a vertex u_i whose neighborhood is exactly the exclusive cell T_i, forcing every total set to meet each T_i. Conversely one chosen vertex per T_i forms a clique and dominates every vertex outside the Jacobson radical. Parity plus this clique gives the paired minimum, with an extra CRT vertex in the odd case. The polynomial is the direct generating function of the all-set classification. Fresh support-union enumeration reproduces the minima through n=5.

final_claim: For a commutative semilocal ring with n at least two maximal ideals, a set totally dominates the reduced comaximal graph exactly when it meets every exclusive maximal-ideal cell; hence \(\gamma_t=n\), \(\gamma_{pr}=2\lceil n/2\rceil\), and for finite vertex sets the total-domination polynomial factors over those cells.
